messages.subject: FitMeasures Crashes
parts:
Hi,
I am running an invariance analysis in 28 countries.
Herewith I attach the  script, and the model summary output. When I try to obtain the fitMeasures the program crashes without any advice. I'm running it in Google Compute and monitoring the instance I checked that it is not a problen of RAM capacity.
Could anyone help me?

MRM

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: FitMeasures Crashes
parts:
MRM

The first simple test would be to run while saving less samples, usually you dont need 10000 saved posterior draws. When estimating the fit measures might be that R is crashing for the size of the object

For example
B_hesit_ctry_config_7=bcfa(model_07, data=data, group="ctry_r", n.chains=3, bcontrol = list(cores = 3), burnin=2500, sample=1500);
